definitions.explanation: A unit of language that carries meaning.
A system of communication used by people.
The way something is said or expressed.

examples.japanese: この{言葉|ことば}の{意味|いみ}がわかりません。
examples.english: I don't understand the meaning of this word.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}は{難|むずか}しい{言葉|ことば}です。
{彼女|かのじょ}の{言葉|ことば}に{感動|かんどう}した。
examples.english: I was moved by her words.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{言葉|ことば}を{覚|おぼ}えました。
その{言葉|ことば}は{使|つか}ったことがありません。
{適切|てきせつ}な{言葉|ことば}が{見|み}つからない。
examples.english: I can't find the right words.

examples.japanese: {言葉|ことば}が{通|つう}じなくて{困|こま}った。
examples.english: I had trouble because the language didn't get through.

examples.japanese: {外国|がいこく}の{言葉|ことば}を{習|なら}いたい。
examples.english: I want to learn a foreign language.

examples.japanese: {母国|ぼこく}の{言葉|ことば}を{大切|たいせつ}にしています。
この{地方|ちほう}の{言葉|ことば}は{独特|どくとく}です。
examples.english: The language of this region is unique.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{言葉|ことば}は{丁寧|ていねい}です。
examples.english: His way of speaking is polite.

examples.japanese: {言葉|ことば}を{選|えら}んで{話|はな}してください。
examples.english: Please choose your words carefully when speaking.

examples.japanese: {乱暴|らんぼう}な{言葉|ことば}を{使|つか}わないで。
{言葉|ことば}が{足|た}りなくてすみません。
examples.english: I'm sorry for not explaining well.

examples.japanese: {優|やさ}しい{言葉|ことば}をかけてくれた。
examples.english: They spoke kind words to me.

notes:
{言葉|ことば} is one of the most fundamental words in Japanese, covering meanings that English splits across "word," "language," and "speech/expression."

COMMON PHRASES:
- {言葉|ことば}が{通|つう}じる: to be understood, to communicate successfully
- {言葉|ことば}に{詰|つ}まる: to be at a loss for words
- {言葉|ことば}を{選|えら}ぶ: to choose one's words carefully
- {言葉|ことば}をかける: to speak to someone, to address
- {言葉|ことば}が{足|た}りない: to fail to express oneself adequately
- {言葉|ことば}に{甘|あま}える: to take someone at their word

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {単語|たんご}: vocabulary word (individual unit, academic)
- {語|ご}: word (suffix for language names: {日本語|にほんご}, {英語|えいご})
- {用語|ようご}: terminology, technical term

NOTE:
When meaning "language," {言葉|ことば} is less formal than {言語|げんご} (language as a system/academic concept). {方言|ほうげん} (dialect) is described as その{土地|とち}の{言葉|ことば} (the local language).
